```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide")

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
has_input_file <- !is.null(input_file) &&
  length(input_file) > 0 &&
  !is.na(input_file) &&
  nzchar(input_file)

if (has_input_file) {
  input_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(input_file, mustWork = FALSE))
  project_dir <- if (basename(input_dir) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(input_dir, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    normalizePath(input_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
  }
} else {
  cwd <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
  project_dir <- if (basename(cwd) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(cwd, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    cwd
  }
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_dir)
setwd(project_dir)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tximport)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(WGCNA)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(Mfuzz)
  library(Biobase)
  library(scales)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(jsonlite)
})


options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
WGCNA::allowWGCNAThreads()

rdata_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "RData")
dir.create(rdata_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

rds_file <- function(name) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, paste0(name, ".rds"))
}

cache_or_run <- function(name, expr, refresh = FALSE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (file.exists(path) && !refresh) {
    message("Loading cached object: ", path)
    readRDS(path)
  } else {
    message("Running and saving object: ", path)
    value <- force(expr)
    saveRDS(value, path)
    value
  }
}

load_rds_object <- function(name, required = TRUE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    if (required) stop("Missing cached object: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  readRDS(path)
}

load_rds_list <- function(name, required = TRUE, envir = .GlobalEnv) {
  value <- load_rds_object(name, required = required)
  if (!is.null(value)) list2env(value, envir = envir)
  invisible(value)
}

analysis_file <- function(...) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
}

input_file_path <- function(...) {
  cached <- file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
  if (file.exists(cached)) return(cached)
  file.path(project_dir, ...)
}

show_table <- function(x, n = 20, title = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    cat("\n### ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (is.null(x)) {
    cat("No object available.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No rows.\n")
    return(invisible(df))
  }
  print(utils::head(df, n))
  invisible(df)
}

show_plot_files <- function(paths) {
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(paths) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  paths <- normalizePath(paths, mustWork = TRUE)
  knitr::include_graphics(paths)
}
```



```{r}
############################################################
## Step 2. Visualization of TNL/CNL/RNL structural-class results
## Input files from previous step:
## 1. NLR_master_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv
## 2. NLR_type_DE_summary_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv
## 3. NLR_type_Mfuzz_cluster_summary_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv
## 4. NLR_type_WGCNA_module_summary_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv
## 5. NLR_type_DE_matrix_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv
## 6. NLR_type_DE_standardized_residuals_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv
############################################################


## -----------------------------
## 0. Settings
## -----------------------------

tcr_levels <- c("TNL", "CNL", "RNL")

outdir <- analysis_file("figures_TNL_CNL_RNL_structure")
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

save_plot <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 7, height = 5) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir, paste0(filename, ".pdf")),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir, paste0(filename, ".png")),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

type_cols <- c(
  TNL = "#7B3294",
  CNL = "#008837",
  RNL = "#E66101"
)

cluster_cols <- c(
  "1" = "#1B9E77",
  "2" = "#D95F02",
  "3" = "#7570B3",
  "4" = "#E7298A",
  "5" = "#66A61E",
  "6" = "#E6AB02"
)


## -----------------------------
## 1. Read result tables
## -----------------------------

nlr_master <- read_tsv(
  analysis_file("NLR_master_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels),
    Cluster = as.character(Cluster),
    Module = as.character(Module)
  )

type_de_summary <- read_tsv(
  analysis_file("NLR_type_DE_summary_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels))

type_cluster_table <- read_tsv(
  analysis_file("NLR_type_Mfuzz_cluster_summary_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels),
    Cluster = as.character(Cluster)
  )

type_module_table <- read_tsv(
  analysis_file("NLR_type_WGCNA_module_summary_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels),
    Module = as.character(Module)
  )

type_de_matrix_df <- read_tsv(
  analysis_file("NLR_type_DE_matrix_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels)) %>%
  arrange(Type)

stdres_df <- read_tsv(
  analysis_file("NLR_type_DE_standardized_residuals_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels)) %>%
  arrange(Type)


## -----------------------------
## 2. Overall Fisher test and pairwise Fisher tests
## -----------------------------

type_de_mat <- type_de_matrix_df %>%
  column_to_rownames("Type") %>%
  as.matrix()

type_de_mat <- type_de_mat[, c("DE", "nonDE"), drop = FALSE]

overall_fisher <- fisher.test(type_de_mat)

cat("\n===== Overall Fisher test: TNL/CNL/RNL =====\n")
print(type_de_mat)
print(overall_fisher)

capture.output(
  overall_fisher,
  file = file.path(outdir, "Fisher_test_overall_TNL_CNL_RNL.txt")
)

pairwise_fisher <- combn(tcr_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  map_dfr(function(pair) {
    
    pair_mat_df <- type_de_matrix_df %>%
      filter(Type %in% pair) %>%
      mutate(Type = factor(Type, levels = pair)) %>%
      arrange(Type)
    
    pair_mat <- pair_mat_df %>%
      dplyr::select(DE, nonDE) %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    rownames(pair_mat) <- as.character(pair_mat_df$Type)
    
    ft <- fisher.test(pair_mat)
    
    tibble(
      comparison = paste(pair, collapse = "_vs_"),
      type1 = pair[1],
      type2 = pair[2],
      type1_DE = pair_mat[pair[1], "DE"],
      type1_nonDE = pair_mat[pair[1], "nonDE"],
      type2_DE = pair_mat[pair[2], "DE"],
      type2_nonDE = pair_mat[pair[2], "nonDE"],
      odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate),
      pvalue = ft$p.value
    )
  }) %>%
  mutate(
    padj_BH = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH")
  )

cat("\n===== Pairwise Fisher tests =====\n")
print(pairwise_fisher)

write_tsv(
  pairwise_fisher,
  file.path(outdir, "Pairwise_Fisher_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv")
)


## -----------------------------
## 3. Figure 1: DE ratio by structural type
## -----------------------------

p_de_ratio <- type_de_summary %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(DE_NLR, "/", Tested_NLR),
    DE_percent = DE_ratio * 100
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Type, y = DE_ratio, fill = Type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = type_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, max(type_de_summary$DE_ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.25)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of time-responsive NLRs by structural class",
    subtitle = paste0("Overall Fisher exact test: p = ", signif(overall_fisher$p.value, 3)),
    x = "NLR structural class",
    y = "DE NLR ratio"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_de_ratio)

save_plot(
  p_de_ratio,
  "Fig1_TCR_DE_ratio",
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)


## -----------------------------
## 4. Figure 2: DE / nonDE stacked bar
## -----------------------------

type_de_long <- type_de_matrix_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("DE", "nonDE"),
    names_to = "DE_status",
    values_to = "NLR_count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    DE_status = factor(DE_status, levels = c("DE", "nonDE")),
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  mutate(
    Type_total = sum(NLR_count),
    ratio = NLR_count / Type_total,
    label = ifelse(NLR_count > 0, as.character(NLR_count), "")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

p_de_stacked <- ggplot(
  type_de_long,
  aes(x = Type, y = ratio, fill = DE_status)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(DE = "#D73027", nonDE = "#D9D9D9")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "DE and non-DE composition of tested NLRs",
    x = "NLR structural class",
    y = "Proportion of tested NLRs",
    fill = "LRT status"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_de_stacked)

save_plot(
  p_de_stacked,
  "Fig2_TCR_DE_nonDE_stacked",
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)


## -----------------------------
## 5. Figure 3: Mfuzz cluster composition
## -----------------------------

cluster_order <- type_cluster_table %>%
  pull(Cluster) %>%
  unique()

if (all(str_detect(cluster_order, "^\\d+$"))) {
  cluster_order <- as.character(sort(as.numeric(cluster_order)))
} else {
  cluster_order <- sort(cluster_order)
}

type_cluster_plot <- type_cluster_table %>%
  mutate(
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels),
    Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = cluster_order),
    label = ifelse(NLR_count > 0, as.character(NLR_count), "")
  )

missing_cluster_cols <- setdiff(levels(type_cluster_plot$Cluster), names(cluster_cols))
if (length(missing_cluster_cols) > 0) {
  extra_cols <- hue_pal()(length(missing_cluster_cols))
  names(extra_cols) <- missing_cluster_cols
  cluster_cols_use <- c(cluster_cols, extra_cols)
} else {
  cluster_cols_use <- cluster_cols
}

p_cluster_stacked <- ggplot(
  type_cluster_plot,
  aes(x = Type, y = Within_type_ratio, fill = Cluster)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_cols_use, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Mfuzz cluster composition of DE NLRs",
    x = "NLR structural class",
    y = "Proportion within structural class",
    fill = "Mfuzz cluster"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_cluster_stacked)

save_plot(
  p_cluster_stacked,
  "Fig3_TCR_Mfuzz_cluster_composition",
  width = 7,
  height = 5
)


## -----------------------------
## 6. Figure 4: Mfuzz cluster heatmap
## -----------------------------

p_cluster_heatmap <- ggplot(
  type_cluster_plot,
  aes(x = Cluster, y = Type, fill = Within_type_ratio)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = NLR_count),
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mfuzz cluster distribution of DE NLRs",
    x = "Mfuzz cluster",
    y = "NLR structural class",
    fill = "Within-class ratio"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

print(p_cluster_heatmap)

save_plot(
  p_cluster_heatmap,
  "Fig4_TCR_Mfuzz_cluster_heatmap",
  width = 6.5,
  height = 4.5
)


## -----------------------------
## 7. Figure 5: WGCNA module heatmap, top modules
## -----------------------------

top_n_modules <- 15

module_order <- type_module_table %>%
  group_by(Module) %>%
  summarise(Total_NLR_count = sum(NLR_count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_NLR_count), Module) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n_modules) %>%
  pull(Module)

type_module_top <- type_module_table %>%
  filter(Module %in% module_order) %>%
  dplyr::select(Type, Module, NLR_count) %>%
  mutate(
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels),
    Module = factor(Module, levels = module_order)
  ) %>%
  complete(
    Type = factor(tcr_levels, levels = tcr_levels),
    Module = factor(module_order, levels = module_order),
    fill = list(NLR_count = 0)
  )

p_module_heatmap <- ggplot(
  type_module_top,
  aes(x = Module, y = Type, fill = NLR_count)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(NLR_count > 0, NLR_count, "")),
    size = 3.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "#2166AC"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Top ", top_n_modules, " WGCNA modules containing DE TNL/CNL/RNL genes"),
    x = "WGCNA module",
    y = "NLR structural class",
    fill = "DE NLR count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

print(p_module_heatmap)

save_plot(
  p_module_heatmap,
  "Fig5_TCR_WGCNA_module_heatmap_top15",
  width = 9,
  height = 4.8
)


## -----------------------------
## 8. Figure 6: WGCNA module stacked bar, top modules
## -----------------------------

type_module_stacked <- type_module_table %>%
  filter(Module %in% module_order) %>%
  mutate(
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels),
    Module = factor(Module, levels = module_order)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  mutate(
    top_module_total = sum(NLR_count),
    ratio_among_top_modules = NLR_count / top_module_total,
    label = ifelse(NLR_count > 0, as.character(NLR_count), "")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

module_cols <- setNames(
  ifelse(module_order %in% colors(), module_order, "grey70"),
  module_order
)

p_module_stacked <- ggplot(
  type_module_stacked,
  aes(x = Type, y = ratio_among_top_modules, fill = Module)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = module_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("WGCNA module composition of DE NLRs, top ", top_n_modules, " modules"),
    x = "NLR structural class",
    y = "Proportion among top modules",
    fill = "WGCNA module"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_module_stacked)

save_plot(
  p_module_stacked,
  "Fig6_TCR_WGCNA_module_stacked_top15",
  width = 8,
  height = 5.5
)


## -----------------------------
## 9. Figure 7: standardized residual heatmap
## -----------------------------

stdres_long <- stdres_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("DE", "nonDE"),
    names_to = "DE_status",
    values_to = "stdres"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels),
    DE_status = factor(DE_status, levels = c("DE", "nonDE")),
    label = sprintf("%.2f", stdres)
  )

max_abs_res <- max(abs(stdres_long$stdres), na.rm = TRUE)

p_stdres <- ggplot(
  stdres_long,
  aes(x = DE_status, y = Type, fill = stdres)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-max_abs_res, max_abs_res)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Standardized residuals of structural class × DE status",
    subtitle = "Positive residual: observed count higher than expected",
    x = "LRT status",
    y = "NLR structural class",
    fill = "Std. residual"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

print(p_stdres)

save_plot(
  p_stdres,
  "Fig7_TCR_DE_standardized_residuals",
  width = 6.2,
  height = 4.5
)
```
```{r}
## -----------------------------
## 10. Export concise text summary
## -----------------------------

type_de_summary_clean <- type_de_summary %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    Type = as.character(Type),
    Total_NLR = as.numeric(Total_NLR),
    Tested_NLR = as.numeric(Tested_NLR),
    DE_NLR = as.numeric(DE_NLR),
    DE_ratio = as.numeric(DE_ratio)
  )

type_cluster_table_clean <- type_cluster_table %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    Type = as.character(Type),
    Cluster = as.character(Cluster),
    NLR_count = as.numeric(NLR_count),
    Within_type_ratio = as.numeric(Within_type_ratio)
  )

type_module_table_clean <- type_module_table %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    Type = as.character(Type),
    Module = as.character(Module),
    NLR_count = as.numeric(NLR_count)
  )

stdres_df_clean <- stdres_df %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    Type = as.character(Type),
    DE = as.numeric(DE),
    nonDE = as.numeric(nonDE)
  )


highest_de_type <- type_de_summary_clean %>%
  arrange(desc(DE_ratio)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)

lowest_de_type <- type_de_summary_clean %>%
  arrange(DE_ratio) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)


dominant_clusters <- type_cluster_table_clean %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  arrange(desc(Within_type_ratio), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()


dominant_modules <- type_module_table_clean %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  arrange(desc(NLR_count), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()


summary_file <- file.path(outdir, "TCR_structure_analysis_summary.txt")

sink(summary_file)

cat("TNL/CNL/RNL structural-class analysis summary\n")
cat("================================================\n\n")

cat("1. DE ratio by structural class\n")
print(type_de_summary_clean)
cat("\n")

cat("2. Overall Fisher exact test\n")
print(overall_fisher)
cat("\n")

cat("3. Pairwise Fisher exact tests\n")
print(pairwise_fisher)
cat("\n")

cat("4. Standardized residuals\n")
print(stdres_df_clean)
cat("\n")

cat("5. Highest and lowest DE ratio\n")
cat(
  "Highest DE ratio:",
  highest_de_type$Type,
  "with",
  highest_de_type$DE_NLR,
  "/",
  highest_de_type$Tested_NLR,
  "DE NLRs; ratio =",
  round(highest_de_type$DE_ratio, 4),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Lowest DE ratio:",
  lowest_de_type$Type,
  "with",
  lowest_de_type$DE_NLR,
  "/",
  lowest_de_type$Tested_NLR,
  "DE NLRs; ratio =",
  round(lowest_de_type$DE_ratio, 4),
  "\n\n"
)

cat("6. Dominant Mfuzz cluster by structural class\n")
print(dominant_clusters)
cat("\n")

cat("7. Dominant WGCNA module by structural class\n")
print(dominant_modules)
cat("\n")

sink()

cat("\nSummary file generated:\n")
cat(summary_file, "\n")


```

```{r display-key-results, results='markup', echo=FALSE}
show_table(type_de_summary, n = 20, title = "DE ratio summary used in figures")
show_table(pairwise_fisher, n = 20, title = "Pairwise Fisher tests")
show_table(dominant_clusters, n = 20, title = "Dominant Mfuzz cluster by structural class")
show_table(dominant_modules, n = 20, title = "Dominant WGCNA module by structural class")
```
